How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question — using it consistently and at the right intensity is what makes the biggest difference. 
Here’s the simple way to get the best results:
Put a bit of moisture on your left tragus
Clip the earpiece on (cable goes over/behind your ear)
Turn it on and slowly increase until you feel a light, pleasant tingling
Keep it at that level (not painful)
Use for 15–60 minutes per session, ideally daily
Best timing: morning, or split between morning and evening before sleep
You can sit, relax, or even work while using it. 
A couple of key tips:
The tingling should feel comfortable — adjust if it fades or gets stronger
Higher intensity isn’t better — it’s about the right sensation, not power
Consistency matters more than one long session
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.
